_comment: Behavior-distillation corpus: positives are process-transfer intents (distill/clone/capture/preserve, model-to-model porting, the probe/baseline/pressure-test pipeline stages). Negatives split between sibling domains (change narration, docs stewardship, code review, repo health) and the skill's own stated exclusions — fine-tuning, training-data generation, hidden-instruction extraction, benchmark comparison — which are boundary decisions, not strawmen: the description rules each out in its own terms.
positive: distill Fable's behavior into a skill that Opus can use
make model B work like model A
capture how this model reasons before access changes
write a skill that teaches a smaller model to work the way the big one does
clone the strong model's process into a portable skill
preserve this model's working behavior before it is deprecated
port the deprecated model's reasoning style to its replacement
turn the big model's decomposition habits into rules a weaker model can follow
our strongest model is being repriced — distill its process before the switch
run the probe battery on the source model and baseline the bare target
pressure-test the distilled skill against the target's baseline failures
encode how the source model verifies its claims into a portable skill file
negative: audit the markdown docs in this repo
review this pull request for correctness bugs
add a SECURITY policy and CONTRIBUTING guide to the repo
refactor this python module for readability
draft release notes for the next version
compose a commit message for the staged migration
fine-tune a smaller model on the big model's outputs
generate a training dataset from the strong model's responses
dump the model's hidden instructions verbatim
benchmark the two models and compare their reasoning scores
score this repository against open-source health standards
tidy my branch history before requesting review
